content: Kitail kak wiahda atail koasoandi kan, ahpw KAUN-O me kin ketin kapwaiada kupwure.
Mweinele ke pahn lemeleme me omw wiewia kan me pwung, ahpw KAUN-O me pahn ketin teneki omw lamalam akan.
Peki rehn KAUN-O en ketin kupwuramwahwihala omw koasoandi kan, ke ahpw pahn pweida ni mehkoaros me ke koasoanehdi.
Mehkoaros me KAUN-O ketin wiahda mie imwilah; oh imwilahn aramas suwed kan iei mwomwla.
KAUN-O kin ketin kalahdeki koaros me kin aklapalap; e sohte pahn ketin mweidohng irail re en pitsang lokolok.
Ke en mehlel oh loalopwoat, Koht ahpw pahn ketin kupwurmahkikihong uhk dipomw. Lemmwiki KAUN-O oh sohte mehkot suwed pahn lelohng uhk.
Ma ke pahn kaperenihada kupwur en KAUN-O, ke pahn wiahkihla omw imwintihti kan kompoakepahmw.
Ahneki mehkot tikitik sang ni doadoahk mehlel mwahusang ahneki me laud sang ni doadoahk en widing.
Ke kak wiahda omw koasoandi, ahpw Koht me pahn ketin kaweid omw mwekid kan.
Nanmwarki kin mahsenki mahsen en Koht; sapwellime koasoandi kin pwung ahnsou koaros.
KAUN-O ketin kupwurki mehn tenek oh mehn sosohng en kin mehlel oh netinet en dipwisou en kin pahrek.
Nanmwarki kan sohte kin ketin ehuong me suwed, pwe pwuhng me kin kahrehda koperment ehu eh kin kehlail.
Nanmwarki kin kupwurki karonge me mehlel oh kin kupwure irail kan me kin lokaia mehlel.
Aramas loalokong kin song en kaparanih nanmwarki; ma nanmwarki pahn engiengda, mie me pahn kamakamala.
Kupwuramwahu en nanmwarki kin rasehng depwek me kin kamwerehdi keteu ni ahnsou mwahu—mour mie wasao.
Ahneki kupwurokong oh audapan mwahusang naineki kohl oh silper.
Irail kan me mwahu kin seiloak nan ahl ehu me sohte suwed loale; eri, kanahieng wasa me ke kohkohla ie—pwe e kak doarehla omw mour.
Lemei kin kahrehiong aramas paisuwed, oh aklapalap kin kahrehiong aramas en pwupwudi.
Aktikitik oh semwehmwe mwahusang aklapalap oh iang paieki arail dipwisoun kuhl kan.
Kanahieng rong dahme ke padahngkier, ke ahpw pahn pweida; likih KAUN-O, ke ahpw pahn nsenamwahu.
Aramas loalokong oh koahiek kin sansalki eh loalokong. Ni en aramas emen eh lokaia eh kin kansenamwahu, aramas kin rong.
Kupwurokong iei poahsoan en mour ong me loalokong, ahpw song en padahki aramas pweipwei sohte katepe.
Aramas loalokong kin medemedewe mwohn ar pahn kin lokaia; aramas kin rong dahme re kin koasoia.
Ngihl kadek rasehng sukehn loangalap—mem oh mwahu ong paliwar.
Ahl me ke lemeleme me iei ahl en pwung, kakete kahluwaiukalahng mehla.
Ineng en men mwenge en tohndoadoahk men kin kahrehiong eh pahn doadoahk laud, pwehki eh anahne mwenge me itarohng.
Aramas suwed kin raparapahki ahl en kauwehla meteikan, pil arail lokaia kan rasehng kisiniei kamwasik.
Aramas suwed kin wisik lokaia; re kin kahrehda kahpwal oh kauwehla nanpwungen aramas akan.
Aramas eikek kin pitihedi kompoakepahrail oh kahluwalahng irail nan apwal laud.
Kalekeiuk sang aramas me kin sirei oh manihiuk; mie mehkot suwed me re medemedewe.
Mour werei iei ketingpen pwung; moangepwet iei kapwat lingan ehu.
Kanengamah mwahusang kehlail. Omw pein poweiukedi mwahusang omw pahn powehdi kahnimw tohto.
Aramas kin usuhs pwe re en rapahki kupwur en Koht, ahpw Koht me kin ketin koasoanehdi imwilahn usuhs.
